ffmpeg.wasm — the engine behind the Video Trimmer & GIF Maker.

Three files make up this dependency, and they are not all under the same
licence, so they are listed separately.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
ffmpeg-core.js and ffmpeg-core.wasm — @ffmpeg/core 0.12.10
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  FFmpeg, compiled to WebAssembly by the ffmpeg.wasm project
  https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm

Licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later. A copy of
version 2 is in LICENSE beside this file, and at:

  https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/gpl-2.0.html

This is the single-threaded build, chosen deliberately: the multi-threaded one
needs SharedArrayBuffer, which needs cross-origin isolation, which would break
every embeddable tool on this site. Both files are redistributed unmodified,
exactly as published to npm, and the corresponding source is the repository
above at the tag for this version.

These are the ESM builds, not the UMD ones, and that is load-bearing. The
wrapper's worker is a module worker, where importScripts does not exist, so the
library falls back to a dynamic import of the core — which a UMD file cannot
satisfy. The .wasm is byte-for-byte the same in both builds; only the loader
differs.

  ffmpeg-core.js
    sha256  67a48f11645f85439f3fde4f2119042c16b374b910206b7a7a24f342e28dcae3
    size    111,804 bytes

  ffmpeg-core.wasm
    sha256  9f57947a5bd530d8f00c5b3f2cb2a3492faa7e5d823315342d6a8656d0a6b7b7
    size    32,232,419 bytes

The .wasm is NOT in this directory. At 30.7 MB it is over the 25 MiB ceiling
Cloudflare puts on a single static asset, so it lives in R2 and the Worker
serves it at /vendor/ffmpeg/ffmpeg-core.wasm — see handleFfmpegCore in
worker/index.ts. It is listed here anyway, because this is the file that
describes what the tool loads, and splitting the record across two places by
where the bytes happen to sit would only hide half of it.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
worker.js — @ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.12.15
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Copyright (c) 2019 Jerome Wu and contributors
  https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm

Licensed under the MIT License.

This one is not redistributed verbatim: it is that package's ESM worker entry
point, bundled with esbuild into a single self-contained module so it can be
served as a plain file. Regenerate it with:

  npx esbuild node_modules/@ffmpeg/ffmpeg/dist/esm/worker.js \
    --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=public/vendor/ffmpeg/worker.js

It is vendored rather than left to the application bundler because the library
loads it with `new Worker(new URL('./worker.js', import.meta.url))`, which is a
pattern bundlers rewrite inconsistently. Passing an explicit classWorkerURL
that points here takes that guesswork out of the build.
